description: This file defines React components for implementing a command palette UI, including dialog wrapping, input handling, and command list items.

methods.name: Command
methods.description: A wrapper around cmdk's Command primitive with custom styling.

methods.name: CommandDialog
methods.description: A composite component that renders a dialog with a command palette and description.

methods.name: CommandInput
methods.description: An input component with a search icon for the command palette.

methods.name: CommandList
methods.description: A styled list container for command items.

methods.name: CommandEmpty
methods.description: Displays a message when no commands are found.

methods.name: CommandGroup
methods.description: A grouping component with a heading for command categories.

methods.name: CommandItem
methods.description: Represents an individual command item with selection styles.

methods.name: CommandSeparator
methods.description: A visual separator between command items.
